title: Core registers
description: The shared registers every management system standard builds on, in five domains: Management system, Risk and controls, Operations, Privacy and security, and Suppliers. Standards are added as add-ons that extend these registers with their own columns, categories and views, so a risk, an incident or a document is recorded once and counts for every standard that uses it.

levels.name: Starter
levels.description: The registers most standards use first: documents and policies, objectives and KPIs, the risk register with its risk categories, incidents, nonconformities and CAPA, and actions.

levels.name: Full
levels.description: Everything in Starter plus the legal register, competence and training, internal audits, management reviews, the controls library and assets.

sheets.description: Every risk and opportunity in one register. Each risk has a category, and each category has its own likelihood and impact scales and its own appetite (Risk categories). The score is likelihood times impact.

values.likelihood_scale: 1 Rare: not expected in the next five years. 2 Unlikely: could happen once in five years. 3 Possible: about once a year. 4 Likely: several times a year. 5 Almost certain: monthly or more often.
values.impact_scale: 1 Negligible: no lasting effect. 2 Minor: dealt with in a day. 3 Moderate: a week of disruption or a customer complaint. 4 Major: lost business, a regulator’s interest or harm to people. 5 Severe: the organisation’s future is at stake.
